Dashboard Overview

Understand what each section means

KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)

These are critical metrics summarising the current state of the institution. Hover over any KPI for a detailed explanation.

Action Queue

Urgent items requiring your review and approval as VP for Academic & Student Affairs. Use the category filters to focus on specific areas.

Charts

  • Enrollment Trend: Monthly headcount showing enrolment peaks and drops across the academic year.
  • Transferee Applicants: Comparison of new applicants vs. accepted transfers.
  • Program Distribution: Student distribution across degree programs.
  • Faculty Performance: Ratings across teaching, research, mentorship, admin, and community engagement – broken down by college. Click the chart to view detailed TER records.
  • Enrolment by College: Stacked bar showing student distribution by year level across colleges.

College Ranking

List of colleges ranked by total student enrolment. Click "View Full Rankings" for more detailed statistics.

Navigation

Use the sidebar to access different modules. Click KPIs or certain charts to drill down for more detail.
